structured_output.what_is_happening: BREW (7Hrk…m9j) looks like a Solana copy riding on Brew (brew.family), a real BNB Chain launchpad with its own BREW token. The real token's price was reported down 44% over the past 24h. This pair was created about 22 minutes ago as a direct PumpSwap pool, not a pump.fun migration (migrated_unix=0, platform unknown). Its liquidity (~$24k) is larger than its market cap (~$13k), 100% of the LP is unlocked, and the creator has already closed its position. The pair shows $272k of volume, with 1,926 unique buyers against only 54 unique sellers. That lopsided ratio suggests bot or dust-buy volume rather than organic demand. Price is down 7–17% over the last 5 minutes. At least 9 other Solana 'BREW' tokens appeared in the last few hours. One of them (4w2N…) already has $0 liquidity, and another (D7UU…) has taken most of the flow at about $121k market cap.
